chunks: ʿAlī, from his father, from al-Nawfalī, from al-Sakūnī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said: “Indeed, the most hated of people to Allah, Mighty and Majestic, is a man who strips the back of a Muslim without right.”

key_terms.جَرَّدَ: laid bare for striking or flogging

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say about unjustly striking or flogging a Muslim?
ai.summary: This hadith strongly condemns wrongfully inflicting punishment or flogging upon a Muslim. It emphasizes the sanctity of a Muslim’s bodily inviolability and shows that unjust aggression is among the deeds most hateful to Allah, Mighty and Majestic.
